synonyms: Argythamnia humilis var. laevis (A.Gray ex Torr.) Shinners
taxonomic_note: Current POWO/WCVP and Flora of North America treatments accept A. humilis and do not maintain the former var. laevis or var. leiosperma segregates.
look_here_first: Do not key this one from low habit alone. Start with the short axillary bisexual raceme and floral details, especially free staminate petals relative to the androphore, then use capsule and seed characters.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Later manual refresh retained exact Harvard specimen evidence for Travis and Comal and added Blanco from USDA-derived county data.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Statewide Texas occurrence is not used as county proof; the PASS rests on the three explicit target counties.

best_field_traits: low perennial or subshrub, stems erect or prostrate
small alternate leaves, obovate to linear, margins entire
staminate petals free from the androphore
very small pistillate petals with flattened stigmas
seeds smooth to rugose or papillate
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Habit and pubescence vary too much for confident separation from A. aphoroides or A. simulans; prioritize inflorescence, flower, capsule, and seed characters.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Reproductive structures outrank overall habit. Use staminate/pistillate floral details, capsule, and seed rather than low stature or hairiness alone.
